title: Цепная реакция разоблачений  (A Chain Reaction of Revelations)

segments.t: Devastated by what he just overheard, Max punches Kostya in the corridor as Nastya cries that Kostya betrayed her with Sasha. Trying to explain himself, Kostya accidentally blurts out 'And Kostya too'—revealing that Sasha had previously cheated on Max with Ilya as well.
Костя мне изменяет, он под Сашей.
Я давно тебе об этом хотел сказать.
Кто еще не переспал Саша, а?
Alright, let's go through it step by step in English.

'What was that for?' Around the situation and work, Barinov wants to know where Kostya really stands. In Russian, he does not need helper words like "do" or "did"—rising pitch alone turns it into a question.

'He still has the nerve to ask what for?' When Kostya asks if he still has the nerve to ask, Barinov has to answer fast. In Russian, he does not need helper words like "do" or "did"—rising pitch alone turns it into a question.
Костя мне изменяет, он под Сашей.
'Kostya is cheating on me, he slept with Sasha.' Once Kostya is cheating on her he slept with Sasha, Sasha can finally tell Barinov what she means.

'Why are you all screaming out here?' Here wondering why Kostya all screaming out here is shows Barinov looking for the real truth. Even in the middle of the drama, he keeps the polite plural "you" that workplace Russian expects.
'And Kostya too.' With the room and conversation in play, Kostya keeps this short reply brisk and direct.
'I will explain everything right now.' Since she will explain everything right now, Sasha does not waste words on excuses.
'What do you mean, 'too'?' Asking what Kostya means is how Barinov puts Kostya on the spot. In Russian, he does not need helper words like "do" or "did"—rising pitch alone turns it into a question.
'No, not 'too'.' With the room and situation in play, Kostya keeps this short reply brisk and direct.
'Sasha cheated on you with Ilya.' Between the room and the situation, Sasha gives Barinov a quick, grounded response.
Я давно тебе об этом хотел сказать.

'I wanted to tell you about it a long time ago.' Explaining that he wanted to tell Kostya about it a long time ago lays the cards on the table for Kostya. Using the informal "you" shows how direct and unfiltered their kitchen relationship is.
Кто еще не переспал Саша, а?

'Who else has not slept with Sasha yet, huh?' Questioning whether who else has not slept with Sasha yet huh is how Kostya tests Barinov's story. In Russian, he does not need helper words like "do" or "did"—rising pitch alone turns it into a question.
'Chef, this bastard slept with Sasha.' Claiming that this bastard slept with Sasha sounds confident, even if Barinov has doubts.

'It is the truth.' Pointing out that it is the truth gives Kostya a sobering reality check. Russian drops "is" in the present, setting the two halves of the thought side by side. Alright, let's listen to all those lines again from the top.
Костя мне изменяет, он под Сашей.
Я давно тебе об этом хотел сказать.
Кто еще не переспал Саша, а?
That wraps up this scene as max punches Kostya in the corridor, and as Kostya tries to defend himself, he accidentally blurts out that Sasha had also cheated on Max with Ilya. Until next time!
